notes.title: A Little (Late) Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Looking back Nephise brought a lot of feedback suggesting the puzzle needs annoyingly too many trials and errors to be solved.
Now I updated the game so when all the four statues face the correct direction, a "bling" sound will be heard which will save you from walking all the way to the bell and back to see if they are correct, in each trial.
Maybe I should have done that change one or two years ago, but this solution has just popped in my mind.
For those who tried the puzzle and gave up due to being stuck, they can try it again. It is more user friendly now.

With love and respect,
Tonguc
